flagship.headline: The Beatles record I Feel Fine with its feedback intro
flagship.summary_line_1: In a nine-hour session at Studio Two, the Beatles cut eight takes of the I Feel Fine rhythm track, with the feedback intro present from the first take, per the Beatles Bible.
flagship.summary_line_2: The same day added Eight Days a Week edit pieces and six more Beatles for Sale tracks, and the clip below is I Feel Fine.

events.headline: The Temptations top the Hot 100 with I Can't Get Next to You
events.summary_line_1: The Temptations' I Can't Get Next to You reached No. 1 on the Billboard Hot 100 on the chart dated October 18, 1969, per Billboard.
events.summary_line_2: Written by Norman Whitfield and Barrett Strong, it held the top spot for two weeks, and the clip below is the record, a hit of Motown psychedelic soul.

events.headline: John Lennon and Yoko Ono are arrested for cannabis possession
events.summary_line_1: Police led by Sergeant Norman Pilcher raided 34 Montagu Square in London at 11:30am and arrested John Lennon and Yoko Ono, per the Beatles Bible.
events.summary_line_2: The flat belonged to Ringo Starr, and Lennon took sole responsibility and pleaded guilty on November 28, and the clip below is Revolution, the 1968 Beatles single.

events.headline: The Beatles finish If I Needed Someone and record In My Life
events.summary_line_1: In Studio Two at EMI Studios, the Beatles added George Harrison's lead vocal, his 12-string Rickenbacker and Ringo Starr's tambourine to If I Needed Someone, per the Beatles Bible.
events.summary_line_2: They then rehearsed and recorded three takes of Lennon's In My Life, which was completed on October 22, and the clip below is If I Needed Someone.

events.headline: The Beatles record I Feel Fine with its feedback intro
events.summary_line_1: In a nine-hour session at Studio Two, the Beatles cut eight takes of the I Feel Fine rhythm track, with the feedback intro present from the first take, per the Beatles Bible.
events.summary_line_2: The same day added Eight Days a Week edit pieces and six more Beatles for Sale tracks, and the clip below is I Feel Fine.

events.headline: Wynton Marsalis is born in New Orleans
events.summary_line_1: Trumpeter and composer Wynton Marsalis was born in New Orleans, the second of six sons of pianist Ellis Marsalis Jr., per BlackPast.
events.summary_line_2: He became artistic director of Jazz at Lincoln Center, and the clip below is Caravan, a Marsalis recording in the jazz tradition.

events.headline: West Side Story opens at the Rivoli Theatre in New York
events.summary_line_1: The film version of West Side Story began its roadshow engagement at the Rivoli Theatre in New York on October 18, 1961, per Cinema Treasures.
events.summary_line_2: The Rivoli run lasted 77 weeks, and the clip below is Rita Moreno's America from the film's soundtrack, with music by Leonard Bernstein.
